seed_link_trigger.question: Does scramble scramble fire the deferred stereo seed-link (channel machinery) trigger?
seed_link_trigger.answer: YES - first curated entry that is mono-only, genuinely stochastic AND seed-reproducible. Verified: science/scramble.c:1123 srand(seed) seeds the rand() behind the osbind drand48 shim; seed is a REQUIRED positional 0-256 with NO unseeded/clock path (omission = 'Insufficient parameters'); same seed byte-identical 1.2 s apart, different seeds differ whenever trns/atten > 0; seed 0 == seed 1 (glibc srand(0)==srand(1), byte-identical); with trns=atten=0 (defaults) the level-sort is deterministic and the seed is inert (seed 5 == seed 9). Stereo refused ('must be mono'). Channel machinery deliberately NOT built (Phase 6 reevaluation decision); entry ships with stereo_link_default 'related', phase_sensitive true, and a known_issues trigger record.

notes: Pinned submode 10 (decreasing level - transient-first decay gesture); submode 9 verified as the exact mirror (first/last 300 ms RMS 0.084/0.466 flips to 0.466/0.084). LOADER CONSTRAINT: KnowledgeIndex keys by (program, mode), so only one scramble scramble entry can exist - a second submode needs an engine change, not a second JSON.
duration_model static: worst -0.23% (enveloped tone), flat-noise fixture -0.005%; trns > 0 adds +/-~1% seed-dependent drift (wavesets resampled) - documented, excluded from the model.

Seed verification: defaults deterministic and seed-inert; -t3 -a0.5 stochastic with working seed (s5==s5 1.2 s apart, s5!=s9, both modes 9 and 10); seed 0 == seed 1; no clock path; seed omission refused.

CDP-enforced ranges: seed 0-256, cnt -c 1-256, trns -t 0-12, atten -a 0-1. trns/atten breakpoint-capable through OUTPUT time (banner-confirmed; brk differs from both scalar endpoints at the same seed); cnt refuses 'Cannot read parameter 3', seed refuses 'Cannot read parameter 2'.
Flags NOT order-enforced (unlike texture); CDP still refuses to overwrite an existing output file (initially misread as an order refusal).
Engine argv verified: 'scramble scramble 10 in.wav out.wav 5 -c1 -t0 -a0' (defaults rendered) byte-equals the bare seed-5 run.

Duration row EXCLUDED from the shared fixture: requires the aux notedata file the fixture cannot supply (texture simple precedent). set_by outdur honesty: -2.0% (outdur 8) to +10.7% (maxdur 1.5); gpsizehi 1001 turned outdur 5 into 58.8 s - the last group's tail scales with gpsizehi x gppakhi + maxdur (first-class landmine, in known_issues).
Working -r seed (mirrors simple): -r5 twice byte-identical, -r5 vs -r9 differ, unseeded differs in samples AND frame count (211225 vs 221414).

MANUAL DIVERGENCE: cgrotext.htm 'All parameters except notedata, outdur and seed may vary over time' - binary REFUSES brkpnt files for gpspace ('Cannot read parameter 14') and contour ('Cannot read parameter 17'); the other 21 numerics + -a/-p/-s all accept (packing verified to differ from both scalar endpoints at seed 5).

DIVERGENCE from texture simple: position -p IS range-enforced here (0-1, -p2 refused); atten 0.000002-1.0 and seed 0-32767 match simple; flag order enforced ('-r5 -a0.5' -> 'option flag -a out of order').

CDP-enforced ranges probed: packing 0.000023-60, gpspace 0-5, gpsprange 0-1, amprise 0-127, contour 0-6, gpsizelo 1-32767, gppaklo/hi 0.022676-60000 ms (srate-dependent min), gpranglo/hi 1-127, phgrid 0-1000.
-w (+33% dur) and -d exposed; -i left unexposed (meaningful only with multiple input sounds). Mono input -> STEREO output; stereo input refused.

duration_model 'indur * repet': exact at repet 2 / rand 0 / offset 0 (4.4000 from 2.2 s; flat fixture 4.0000 from 2.0); +1.4%/+2.0% splice-overlap drift at repet 3/4; offset > 0 and rand > 0 REDUCE output below the model (safe direction).

CLOCK-SEEDED STOCHASTIC, UNSEEDABLE (first-class finding): rand > 0 calls initrand48() = srand(time(0)) (envspeak.c:1425 / osbind.c); mode 1 has no seed param (ESPK_SEED is mode 11 only, line 2122). rand 0.5 runs 1.2 s apart differ in samples AND duration (3.7852 vs 3.8439); same-second collision trap applies. rand 0 (curated default) fully deterministic.
CONTENT REFUSAL: steady tone -> 'FAILED TO FIND ANY ENVELOPE TROUGHS IN THE FILE.' Flat noise, click trains, enveloped noise all fine.

FEEDBACK +/-1 HANGS (first-class landmine): CDP-enforced range is -1 to 1, but at exactly +/-1 the internal tail-measuring pass ('Checking levels and length of tail', domulti_test in new/newdelay.c) never converges - still running at 40 s on a 2 s input. Curated range engine-narrowed to +/-0.99 (0.99 completes <1 s, outdur 8.97).

The decay tail is measured adaptively by the binary (no closed form). Curated expression 'indur + period(midipitch) * 18.5 * (|fb|+1) / (2*(1-|fb|))' (Pade ln approximation, constant fitted high) over-predicts on EVERY probe row: +0.7% to +4.9% across midipitch 24-84 / |fb| 0.3-0.99 / mix 0.5-1, worst +37.1% at midipitch -12; never under-predicts. Verified to evaluate under the repo's simpleeval (ternary + ** + bool ops). Flat-noise fixture row: pred 2.2003 vs 2.1689 actual (+1.45%, within 0.05).
